data.content: FACT: The only '150' in agent-tools.ts is a comment (:1229). The real global cap is DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS+DEFAULT_QUEUE_DEPTH on TOTAL spawn count in agent_spawn (:1249, returns busy:queue-full), NOT a provider-dispatch gate. Provider dispatch concurrency is governed solely by per-provider caps (deepseek/openrouter=20). Do not conflate the spawn hard-cap with the dispatch cap.
